title: Hybrid Connectivity Decision Cheat Sheet — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes PCA Hybrid Connectivity Decision Matrix: Cloud VPN (HA VPN with dynamic BGP, max 3Gbps/tunnel) vs Dedicated Interconnect (10G/100G physical cross-connect) vs Partner Interconnect (50M-10G via service provider) vs Cross-Cloud Interconnect vs Carrier Peering.
routing_rationale: Choosing hybrid cloud networking requires evaluating bandwidth, encryption, physical colocation presence, and SLA targets: 99.99% high availability mandates dual colocation facilities and four cross-connects.

nodes.label: Bandwidth > 10Gbps Required?
nodes.detail: Demands 10Gbps to 100Gbps dedicated pipe without public internet transit.

nodes.label: Bandwidth < 3Gbps / Low Budget?
nodes.detail: Fast setup (hours), encrypted IPsec, dynamic BGP routing, lower cost.

nodes.label: Dedicated Interconnect (10/100G)
nodes.detail: Direct fiber connection at Google colocation facility; 99.99% SLA architecture.

nodes.label: Partner Interconnect (50M-10G)
nodes.detail: For enterprises whose data center is not colocated with a Google facility.

nodes.label: Cloud HA VPN (99.99% SLA)
nodes.detail: IPsec encrypted tunnels (max 3Gbps per tunnel); supports active-active BGP routing.

nodes.label: Cross-Cloud Interconnect
nodes.detail: Pre-provisioned physical connection between Google Cloud and AWS/Azure datacenters.

edges.label: 2. Sub-10Gbps or Not Colocated -> Partner Interconnect

steps.title: Bandwidth & Physical Presence Evaluation
steps.action: Assesses physical datacenter location and throughput volume.
steps.why_traversal: Dedicated Interconnect requires customer presence in Google colocation facility.

steps.title: Encryption & Multi-Cloud Evaluation
steps.action: Selects HA VPN for IPsec encryption or Cross-Cloud Interconnect for AWS/Azure.
steps.why_traversal: Provides secure, high-availability hybrid connectivity matched to budget.

scenarios.label: Interconnect Lacks IPsec for Regulated Data
scenarios.root_cause: Compliance auditor rejected standard Interconnect because traffic was unencrypted on wire.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy Cloud HA VPN over Cloud Interconnect or enable MACsec encryption on Dedicated Interconnect.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Visualizes PCA Hybrid Connectivity Decision Matrix: Cloud VPN (HA VPN with dynamic BGP, max 3Gbps/tunnel) vs Dedicated Interconnect (10G/100G physical cross-connect) vs Partner Interconnect (50M-10G via service provider) vs Cross-Cloud Interconnect vs Carrier Peering.
